name: 2 tc fort build feudal into raider elephants etc season 12
author: PeNDraGoN

notes: 6 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ , build 1 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ instantly and use them to scout for sheep left and right

@resource/rally.webp@2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to  @resource/resource_gold.webp@ build @building_economy/house.webp@ with 1st civ (make sure this is a good place for fort later, you surround the fort with farms and houses  then change @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@
Bring @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ back to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ for 50 ish seconds

On 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@  move 2  @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @resource/resource_gold.webp@  and 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@  to @resource/resource_stone.webp@and also move the @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@
move other @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ line and drop of its @resource/sheep.webp@

on age up use 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@   from  @resource/sheep.webp@ and 1 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@   @resource/rally.webp@from  @building_economy/town-center.webp@to age up with @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@ 2nd @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ (TOTAL OF 5)

rally @building_economy/town-center.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ till 8  move 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@  from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ ( you want 4 on food)

when age up is complete take 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@   and move to @resource/sheep.webp@  then take 1 other @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and move to build @building_economy/house.webp@  at 1st @building_economy/house.webp@ rally 2nd house @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to build  @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ with @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@(step below)

take 4 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and build @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ near @building_economy/house.webp@ and @resource/resource_gold.webp@ total of 5 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ building it

at around 7 mins to 7-30 build @building_military/barracks.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@  depending on whats best, @building_military/barracks.webp@ into  @building_military/stable.webp@    vs @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@ civs

description: An aggressive build designed around feudal fighting with healer elephants
name: Tughlaq Fast Castle (DLC RELEASE VERSION)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 6 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ and 3 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to collect sheep around the base and map.
@resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 4 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and send 1 of your 3 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ there for drop off
During age up, gather 1 full @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (150w) and collect 50 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ for @technology_defensive/arrow-slits.webp@.
Construct a @building_economy/house.webp@ & a @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and get @technology_defensive/arrow-slits.webp@
Feudal is simple. Just rally food until age 3 ;)
@building_economy/house.webp@ & queue Imams out of @landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@ to pickup @resource/relics.webp@ if no pressure

Now you spam @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@ & @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ in age 3 and take relics. Classic castle age meta play. When the game reaches 15-18 minute mark, you send villagers to stone for the Governor @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ to start farm transitioning around that fort. Should you get a lot of relics then go @ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ for gold income. You can also play @unit_delhi/war-elephant.webp@+@unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ in castle, if your opponent decided to make feudal units. Simply start with archers instead. Don't forget about upgrades and spam Imams for big heals on your units!

description: Feudal Aggro with Raider Elephants supported by a Healer Elephant. Super fast aggro that bullies the opponent into idling vills lest you trample them. Follow with Archers to deal with Spearmen.
name: Feudal Aggro with Raider and Healer Elephants
author: Eldritch

notes: Queue @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@an send all @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and the @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ the second new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and build @building_economy/house.webp@ first
@resource/rally.webp@ 1 more @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@ then @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ until age-up

Move @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and 1 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ there until 4
Build @building_military/stable.webp@ with the 4 age-up @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ then go back to @resource/berrybush.webp@
Produce 2 @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ to enemy base to deny resources
Produce 1 @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ and send to assist your 2 @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@
Once at 16 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and produce a @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ if necessary

Once you have 2 @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@ and 1 @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ produce 2 more @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@ an 1 more @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@
Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ if opponent goes @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and produce @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@

description: Transcripted from Corvinus1's video for me to understand
name: Corvinus' Tower of victory+2TC+Fort BOOM
author: murtuk

notes: Make 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@or@resource/deer.webp@ with 10 from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ back to @resource/resource_food.webp@
Now go production (@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@+@unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@) then @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@ and WIN!
Age up with 3 @resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ with @landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@ (@landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@ can be playable)

Keep mining @resource/resource_stone.webp@ until there is 320 stone remaining then send @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and add 2 more @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@
Produce army to counter ennemy civ and produce @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@

description: Simple Tughlaq Dynasty Build Order by Beasty
name: Simple Tughlaq Dynasty - Beasty
author: Niki45nk

notes: [If desired] Immediately make 2 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ from @building_economy/town-center.webp@ to collect @resource/sheep.webp@
1 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ scouts behind your base, then goes to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Rally @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and Right-click 1 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to the same @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@
Immediately and Always make @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ at @landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@ to harass enemy @resource/resource_gold.webp@

when ~400 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@6 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ build @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@@ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ next to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ & @building_economy/house.webp@ to gain @resource/resource_food.webp@

@@landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@ ready send @abilities/repair.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ & start producing @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ non stop
Start harassing enemy, Scout for their Produciotn and build @building_military/archery-range.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@@building_military/barracks.webp@ accordingly

description: See build video for very useful advice
name: Fast 2TC + Tughlaq Fort Build (2026)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 4 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ go to @resource/berrybush.webp@ with @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ & 2 go to @resource/sheep.webp@. You also want to spawn a 2nd @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to collect sheep around base and go to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Take 4 @resource/sheep.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and go to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (make sure you have all 3)
2 age-up @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ will build the @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ inbetween 2nd TC placement and Main TC with 8 tiles space. (see video for placement guidance here)

470/1200 left in @resource/resource_stone.webp@mine pull all @resource/resource_stone.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ away and walk towards @resource/resource_gold.webp@and build @building_economy/town-center.webp@
Afterwards scout opponent and make units or go FC if they also boom.

description:
Easy 2 TC build order and tips for the mid and late game.

Check my other tughlaq guides:
- FC: https://aoe4guides.com/edit/cQ9LjFfmsY5XCVtfhXQS
name: Tughlaq | 2TC
author: Jockxtar

notes: Make 1 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ and send it to scout for @resource/sheep.webp@ around @resource/resource_gold.webp@
When @building_economy/house.webp@ is about to finish, position second @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ near @resource/resource_gold.webp@
@landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@: Is better for the late game but barely noticeable in the early game. Strong but risky.

@landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@: @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ on @age/age_2.webp@ are super strong, specially in the first few minutes of the game. This can help us defend until we recover the investment on the @building_economy/town-center.webp@. Much safer but worse scaling.
Leave the 4 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to later build and upgrade @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@

When you get 400 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, build @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ near your two @building_economy/town-center.webp@ with at least 2 empty tiles around it to build @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/farm.webp@.

Select @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ as the governor for this @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@. The passive @resource/resource_food.webp@ will help us fund the extra @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ production and eventually go to @age/age_3.webp@.
Prioritize upgrading it rather than building new @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@.

If the opponent is playing aggressive and forces you to make units in @age/age_2.webp@, build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and research the upgrades, otherwise you will soon start floating @resource/resource_gold.webp@
@landmark_delhi/house-of-learning.webp@: Offers excellent upgrades for our core units (the elephants).

@landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@: Since we are already playing very greedy with the second @building_economy/town-center.webp@, focusing on building and upgrading @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ is too greedy.
During age up make sure to build another @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ and assign @ability_tughluq/uch.webp@ as its governor for the discounts on upgrades.
Gradually build @building_economy/farm.webp@ and @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ to complete your economy.
Defend with an infantry army (@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ + @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@) and raid with @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:
@building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ governors priority: @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ (tier 3) followed by @ability_tughluq/uch.webp@ (tier 1). Then pick based on the situation:
@ability_tughluq/ajmer.webp@ if under inmediate threat or to help secure an exposed @resource/resource_gold.webp@ vein.
@ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ if you manage to grab some @resource/relics.webp@.
@ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ for a stronger cavalry army. Preferably leave it for later.
@ability_tughluq/multan.webp@ if you don't need/want the others. A bit unnecessary.

@landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@: Can generate up to 300 @resource/resource_food.webp@ and 300 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ per minute, which is incredibly useful for the ideal @civilization_flag/tug.webp@ army that requires a lot of @resource/resource_gold.webp@.

@landmark_delhi/palace-of-the-sultan.webp@: The only tier 4 governor effects that are worth are @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ for more resources and @ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ for a bit of extra health on cavalry or @ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ for more healing on @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@.
Since we have already built and upgraded @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@, we can discard that option.

@ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ only grants 15 more health compared to the tier 3 effect, so it's not really worth it, although it can be useful for a timing attack right after aging up; since we are skipping the several minutes it takes to build and upgrade the @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ (and the @resource/resource_stone.webp@ cost).

@ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ is ok, but nothing too crazy, and adding @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ is very expensive for the stats they provide. It's good to have a few of them, but investing an entire landmark to buff them is not optimal.
